2847d66d5679ee28e006b3eb2a330eebdd20bdcb.summary: Mandiant and Google Threat Intelligence Group report zero-day exploitation of CVE-2026-22769 (CVSSv3.1 10.0) in Dell RecoverPoint for Virtual Machines by UNC6201, a suspected PRC-nexus cluster, since at least mid-2024. The actor used hard-coded default Tomcat Manager credentials to deploy a SLAYSTYLE web shell, then backdoors SLAYSTYLE, BRICKSTORM and GRIMBOLT, with persistence through a boot-time script. The report also describes VMware pivoting using Ghost NICs and iptables-based Single Packet Authorization. Initial access was not confirmed. Dell has released remediations.
